mapper.sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_no, o.reporter_id, u.real_name AS reporter_name, o.device_id, d.device_name, d.room_name, o.fault_desc, o.priority, o.status, o.created_at, o.updated_at FROM repair_order o JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.reporter_id JOIN device d ON d.id = o.device_id
mapper.select: WHERE o.reporter_id = #{reporterId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repair_order WHERE status <> 'CLOSED'
SELECT ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, o.created_at, l.created_at)) / 60, 2) FROM repair_order o JOIN status_log l ON l.order_id = o.id AND l.to_status = 'CLOSED'
SELECT d.room_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM repair_order o JOIN device d ON d.id = o.device_id WHERE o.status <> 'CLOSED' GROUP BY d.room_name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT status AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM repair_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC
